description: The 72 relics of Galturn's grimoire: each one an angel, a demon and one of Wukong's transformations, with real rule changes (lower quotas, hate shields, extra memes, veto immunity…). Win the daily challenge to open the page of the day forever; find more as rewards inside runs (they stay if you finish a daily with ELO 12+); bring up to 3 into any run. With your key it marks the ones in your grimoire. — Las 72 reliquias: catálogo y tu grimorio.

token.description: optional: your key, to mark your grimoire (not needed if connected with ?a=KEY)
